_note: Response transform configuration template. Maps raw API/MCP responses to AI-friendly clean formats. Place a copy in your server's config/ directory and populate transform profiles for each instruction your server handles. Swap this file to adapt to different upstream APIs — no code changes needed.
_design: Each service has its own response_transform.json. Different services connect to different APIs with different raw response structures. The transform profiles normalize them into consistent output formats that Agents can read with minimal token cost.
_when_loaded: Level 5+ (self-hosted endpoint). Level 0-4 users receive pre-transformed responses from their endpoints.
_philosophy: MCP standardizes how you CALL tools, not what they RETURN. response_transform.json fills that gap — it makes return values AI-readable, not just machine-readable.

<transform_profile_id>.description: <human-readable description of what this transform does>
<transform_profile_id>.source_paths: <optional, documentation of raw response paths used>

geocode-brief.description: 地理编码响应→简要位置信息（~50 token）

geocode-full.description: 地理编码响应→完整位置信息（含 POI）

passthrough.description: 不变换，原样返回。当 API 响应已足够简洁时使用。

_design_notes.transform_vs_path: Transform happens AFTER a single instruction executes. It's a config-driven cleanup, not a multi-step orchestration. For multi-step workflows, use paths (Level 4).
_design_notes.transform_vs_route: Routing (routing_preferences.json) chooses WHICH backend to call. Transform cleans WHAT comes back. They're orthogonal — you can route to MCP and still apply a transform.
_design_notes.performance: Transforms run server-side inside the endpoint process. Zero additional network round-trips. Agent receives clean output directly.
